text: {"lessons":["Because prices move randomly, recent gains or losses do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid trading based on price history alone.","Selling Stock B and Stock D locked in gains and felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on my investment plan rather than the pleasure of realizing a gain.","A small change in account value over a period is not by itself a reason to trade; I should weigh risk and diversification while resisting frequent reactions to daily movements."]}
